title: Industry Day for Toll Management Solutions
description: Thank you for your participation and for submitting your questions to GSA Fleet Toll Management Solution RFI and Industry Day. This action is to post the Government's response to the RFI and Industry day questions and provide the link to the Industry Day event recording. The Government is seeking information from interested and qualified vendors that can provide nationwide tolling management services for a large federally leased vehicle fleet consisting of more than 230,000 vehicles, with the potential fleet size and associated requirements to increase over time as well as the possibility to include services for agency owned, non-postal service federal vehicles. Please see attached RFI and question matrix.

description: T-BOS Acquisition Update�19 Aug 2026: Notice of Scope Revision and Strategic Procurement Pause The 764th Enterprise Sourcing Squadron is issuing this update to inform industry of a significant scope revision and subsequent schedule delay for the T�rkiye Base Operating Support (T-BOS) acquisition. 1. Cancellation of Current Descoping Actions / Restoration of Current Requirement Following the conclusion of mediation between the U.S. Government and the Turkish labor union (T�rk Harb-??) regarding the new 2-year Collective Labor Agreement (CLA), the Government made a strategic decision to continue all BOS functions as a consolidated requirement. The previously announced strategy to immediately descope approximately 175 Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) positions from the core T-BOS solicitation has been cancelled 2. Impact on Local Contract Actions The 39th Contracting Squadron (39 CONS) at Incirlik AB is currently in the process of formally cancelling the four associated local contract actions and solicitations for these services. All offerors and awardees involved in those local 39 CONS actions will receive separate, direct communications from their respective Contracting Officers. 3. Schedule Impact and Next Steps Because this scope restoration fundamentally alters the PWS, the baseline cost data, and the evaluation criteria previously published in the Draft RFP, the Final RFP will not be released this month as originally projected. The Government will reconvene an Acquisition Strategy Panel (ASP) to thoroughly review the impact of these changes on the overall procurement strategy. Industry partners should anticipate a strategic pause of approximately 90 to 120 days. During this time, the Government will revise the PWS, and sanitized cost baseline estimates to reflect the newly signed CLA. Once an updated plan is formally approved, the Government will post an additional update to outline the revised acquisition strategy, define the future procurement pathway, and publish a new milestone schedule. As part of this comprehensive reassessment, the Government may also issue supplemental requests for information or conduct additional market research to ensure our final approach aligns with current market capabilities. We appreciate the significant time and resources industry has already invested in reviewing our previous draft documents. We remain committed to maximizing transparency as we adapt to these emergent operational realities. John S. title: collecte et valorisation des déchets biodégradables issus des ménages sur le territoire de Kriegstetten
description:
Effectuer la collecte des déchets biodégradables issus des ménages sur le territoire de Kriegstetten et réaliser la valorisation des déchets biodégradables collectés. Le lieu de valorisation peut être choisi librement (usine de méthanisation ou centre de compostage). Les collectes de déchets biodégradables doivent être effectuées à l’aide d’un camion-poubelle (chargeuse arrière) équipé d’un système de vidage à peigne.

23 collectes au total ont lieu par an. Deux collectes par mois de février à novembre (trois collectes en juin ou juillet) et une collecte par mois en décembre et janvier.

Compte tenu du fait que les communes de Halten, Oekingen et Kriegstetten ont été regroupées, il existait auparavant différents systèmes de collecte (financement et saisie des quantités). Les données collectées dont on dispose ne couvrant pas tout le territoire, on utilise un historique de volume modélisé pour l’appel d’offres.

Les rues dont il faut s’occuper sont représentées dans l’annexe 6. Le prestataire est libre de choisir son itinéraire tant qu’un service irréprochable est garanti. Une fois l’itinéraire défini, le prestataire transmet à la commune le tracé de l’itinéraire sous forme de plan (cela ne s’applique pas à la soumission des offres, mais uniquement au prestataire retenu).

La commune offre aux habitant·e·s un service de broyage des végétaux cinq fois par an. Dans le présent appel d’offres, ce service est proposé en option supplémentaire.

Les spécifications détaillées des prestations figurent dans le cahier des charges.

description: The Swedish Migration Agency's (SMA) is tasked with driving and coordinating the international cooperations operated through its programme for International Development Cooperation. In this role, the SMA carries out initiatives in third countries to strengthen their capacity to manage migration. The work is primarily conducted through development cooperation projects. The SMA has a development project with Somalia, Capacity Building for Efficient Migration Management in Somalia (CapSom) within the framework of a bilateral cooperation linked to Sweden's development aid efforts. The purpose is to support Somalia in building its capacity for sustainable migration management and reintegration, thereby contributing to procedures that promote safe, orderly and regular migration. CapSom is implemented by the SMA with Somalia's National Commission for Refugees and IDP's (NCRI) as partner institution. The project is funded by the Swedish International Development Cooperation Agency (Sida) and implemented from April 2026 to March 2027. To achieve the overall goals of the project the SMA seeks to engage an institution/organisation, hereafter the Contractor, to deliver targeted project activities taking place in Somalia.

description: Omschrijving van de Opdracht De Opdrachtgever wil een raamovereenkomst afsluiten met één (1) opdrachtnemer voor interne verhuisdiensten met een initiële looptijd van twee (2) jaar met de mogelijkheid om deze overeenkomst tweemaal met één jaar te verlengen. Scope van de Opdracht De scope omvat alle transport-, verzamel- en laadwerkzaamheden die worden uitgevoerd vanuit het centrale magazijn van Stichting Watermaatschappij Amsterdam, gevestigd aan de Driemondeweg 21 te Amsterdam (Weesperkarspel). Deze werkzaamheden ondersteunen zowel de operationele activiteiten van Stichting Watermaatschappij Amsterdam in Amsterdam en omliggende regio’s, als de bevoorrading van andere Waternet‑magazijnen. De chauffeurs zijn verantwoordelijk voor het veilig en efficiënt verzamelen, assembleren en laden en vervoeren van uiteenlopende materialen (containers, buizen van diverse lengte en diameters, pallets, hekwerken, pompen in verschillende disciplines) die benodigd zijn voor werkzaamheden in het waterbeheer, rioolbeheer en overige operationele diensten van Stichting Watermaatschappij Amsterdam. title: Netherlands – Software package and information systems – Energie- Management Systeem
description: De Opdracht omvat de levering, implementatie en ondersteuning van een nieuw Energie- Management Systeem (EnMS) voor de Universiteit Leiden. Een goed functionerend Energieregistratie- en Bewakingssysteem (EBS) maakt integraal onderdeel uit van de EnMS-oplossing. Voor het merendeel van de gebouwen is een EBS wettelijk verplicht. De EnMS-oplossing dient daarom te voldoen aan de geldende richtlijnen zoals vastgesteld door de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO). Met deze aanbesteding beoogt de Opdrachtgever te beschikken over een schaalbare, toekomstbestendige en veilig ingerichte SaaS-oplossing die betrouwbare energie-informatie ontsluit en ondersteuning biedt bij wettelijke verplichtingen, financiële processen en duurzaamheidsdoelstellingen. Het EnMS fungeert daarbij als het primaire systeem voor langetermijnopslag, beheer en analyse van energiedata van de Opdrachtgever. Het EnMS dient op een robuuste en herleidbare wijze te integreren met bestaande systemen en databronnen van de Universiteit Leiden en geschikt te zijn voor gegevensuitwisseling binnen de bestaande informatievoorziening. De Opdracht bestaat uit de volgende onderdelen: de levering, implementatie en ondersteuning van een EnMS als SaaS-oplossing de levering van monitoringsdiensten gericht op datakwaliteit en continuïteit de levering van aanvullende functionaliteit modules en dashboards (optioneel) Voor onderdeel 3 geldt geen afnameverplichting. De Opdrachtgever wil modules en dashboards naar gelang van gebruik optioneel en afzonderlijk van elkaar kunnen afnemen gedurende de looptijd van de Overeenkomst. Het al dan niet volledig aanbieden van onderdeel 3 vormt geen uitsluitingsgrond. De mate waarin de functionaliteit van de uitgevraagde modules en/of dashboards wordt aangeboden, wordt wel betrokken bij de kwaliteitsbeoordeling van de inschrijving.

Kommunen varetager de sædvanlige kommunale opgaver, herunder drift af skoler, dagtilbud, plejehjem og øvrige sociale institutioner, administration, tekniske anlæg samt fritids- og kulturtilbud.Udbuddet er opdelt i 9 delaftaler, som tilbudsgiver kan byde på enkeltvis, flere ad gangen eller samlet:Bygnings- og løsøreforsikringArbejdsskadeforsikring (katastrofedækning), med option på lovpligtig arbejdsskadeKollektiv ulykkesforsikringErhvervs- og produktansvarsforsikring, inkl. ansvar for plejeanbragte børn og professionelt ansvar for kommunal rådgivningDirektions- og bestyrelsesansvarsforsikringSøfartøjerRejseforsikringMotorkøretøjsforsikringPatientansvarsforsikring (option)Ordregivers bygningsmasse omfatter 123 forsikringssteder, herunder skoler, plejehjem og øvrige kommunale institutioner, med en samlet løsøresum på cirka DKK 385.000.000.Kontrakterne indgås for en fast periode på 3 år fra 1. januar 2027 til og med 31. december 2029, med mulighed for forlængelse i op til yderligere 2 år. Tildeling sker pr. delaftale efter tildelingskriteriet "bedste forhold mellem pris og kvalitet", hvor pris vægter 60 % og dækningsomfang (kvalitet) vægter 40 %.

title: Denmark – Repair and maintenance services – Udbud af driftsaftale til Nautila billetautomater
description: DSB har 368 Nautila billetautomater fordelt på stationer over hele landet, hvor DSB’s kunder kan købe billetter, pendlerkort og andre produkter. DSB ønsker, at Nautila fremstår i god stand, altid er funktionsdygtige og fungerer efter hensigten, herunder at vedligehold af automaterne udføres systematisk efter vedligeholdelsesplaner, så driften er stabil og understøtter DSB’s kunder. DSB er ved at udskifte de eksisterende Nautila billetautomater, da billetautomaterne snart vil være forældede. Udfasning af de eksisterende billetautomater vil forventeligt påbegyndes primo 2028 med en endelig udfasning forventeligt primo 2029. Formålet med nærværende Aftale er at indgå aftale med en leverandør, der kan drifte og vedligeholde DSB’s eksisterende Nautilla billetautomater indtil, at disse er endeligt udfaset. Aftalen omfatter generel servicering og vedligehold af DSB’s Nautila billetautomater i henhold til kravene angivet i Bilag 02. Aftalen indeholder både planlagte Eftersyn som angivet i Bilag 02, ikke-planlagte vedligeholdelsesarbejder og akutte vedligeholdelsesarbejder herunder udbedring af funktionsudfald og reparationer.

description: Deze aanbesteding betreft een Europese aanbesteding ten behoeve van Leveringen overeenkomstig het Aanbestedingsreglement Werken 2016 (hoofdstuk 2) voor de gemeente Harderwijk. Deze openbare aanbesteding is online gepubliceerd. Alle ondernemers, die aan de gestelde eisen voldoen, mogen inschrijven. Op deze opdracht zijn de Uniforme Administratieve Voorwaarden (UAV) van toepassing. De Overeenkomst is geldig voor de duur van het uit te voeren werk. Deze Opdracht wordt in zijn geheel aanbesteed, er is geen sprake van perceelvorming. De Opdracht wordt gegund aan de inschrijver die de economisch meest voordelige inschrijving heeft gedaan op basis van de laagste prijs. De beschrijvingen in Mercell Source-to-Contract, behorend bij deze aanbesteding, bevatten informatie die geïnteresseerde partijen nodig hebben om een beeld te kunnen vormen van de inhoud van de Opdracht om zodoende te kunnen beslissen al dan niet een Inschrijving in te dienen. Daarnaast bevat het Offerteverzoek de benodigde informatie en worden geïnteresseerde partijen door middel van dit Offerteverzoek nader geïnformeerd over de procedure die de Aanbestedende dienst zal volgen om tot een Overeenkomst te komen. Alle informatie in dit Offerteverzoek dient vertrouwelijk te worden behandeld. Leeswijzer Deze aanbesteding zal verlopen via het Digitale Aanbestedingsplatform Mercell Source-to-Contract. Voor het gebruik van Mercell Source-to-Contract is de 'Instructie Digitaal Aanbieden' opgesteld. U kijkt nu naar 'Stap 1: Informatie'. Hier treft u alle informatie omtrent deze aanbesteding. Door op de blauwe 'Start' knop te klikken kunt u beginnen met de prijs- en vragenlijst(en) te beantwoorden. Achter deze knop treft u voor onderhavige aanbesteding de relevante stukken. title: Norway – Health and social work services – Procurement of home services
description: Oslo municipality c/o the Norwegian Welfare Administration shall procure new framework agreements for home health services, hereafter called home services. The framework agreements include district nursing and personal assistance in the form of practical assistance. Home nursing care is provided either by spot day, evening and/or night, or as stationary service throughout or parts of the day. The services are covered by the user choice scheme for home services. The user choice in the home care service applies to persons with decisions on home nursing care or practical assistance who live or stay in Oslo municipality. The aim is to give users greater influence, flexibility and freedom of choice, by giving users the right to choose whether the service should be provided by a municipal executive or by a private service provider with a framework agreement. The users can choose a service provider for practical assistance and home nursing. The users can at any time choose new executing of their service offer. The aim of this procurement is to enter into framework agreements with private suppliers who ensure good and adapted services for the entire target group, as well as facilitate for functioning user choices. All users of home services shall receive equal services regardless of whether they choose municipal service provider or private service provider. The framework agreements shall create long-term predictability regarding service offers and finance for users, district and suppliers.

title: Norway – Construction work for pipelines, communication and power lines, for highways, roads, airfields and railways; flatwork – Competition - Framework agreement for renovation no-dig, water pipelines including manholes.
description: The framework agreement is for the renovation of water pipelines and manholes when blocking out. Controlled drilling, pilot pipe drilling and hose renovation are not included in the framework agreement. The aim of the framework agreement is to cover the need for renovation of water pipelines, where blocking out can be used as a method, as well as renovation of manholes and re-connection of private service pipes. In addition to blocking out, there will be a limited need for renovation by using traditional trench excavation in cases where blocking out cannot be carried out. The contracting authority is planning for two call-offs per annum, with each call-off consisting of packing several measures. The contracting authority plans to renovate approx. 3,000 metres per annum and increase the number of metres during the contract period. The actual extent will vary, however, and the contracting authority is not obligated to the above mentioned estimate. In addition to planned measures, urgent orders may occur. The framework agreement ́s estimated financial framework, including an option for an extension, is NOK 415,000,000,-, while the maximum limit is NOK 600,000,000,-. This is based on a calculation of the estimated price of 3,000 metres per annum, which can be increased to 4,000 metres per annum. The framework agreement period is 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 years.

title: Norway – Research and development services and related consultancy services – Evaluation of Five Pilot Projects Testing Exemptions from Provisions of the Local Government Act, the Property Tax Act, the General Practitioner Regulations, and Other Regulatory Frameworks
description: In 2023, the Government invited municipalities and county authorities to apply to participate in the Government’s pilot scheme for municipalities and county authorities. The scheme allows municipalities to test new ways of carrying out their tasks through exemptions from existing regulations. These pilot projects are based on the Act relating to Experiments in Public Administration of 26 June 1992 (the Experimental Administration Act), hereinafter referred to as the Experimental Administration Act. Further information about the framework of the scheme is available on the Ministry’s webpage dedicated to the pilot scheme. This assignment involves evaluating the following five pilot projects: - A pilot project to operate a joint primary healthcare service within an inter-municipal cooperative arrangement involving four municipalities in the Inner Namdal region of Trøndelag (Grong, Lierne, Namsskogan and Røyrvik). - A pilot project in Nordre Follo Municipality aimed at improving dialogue between the municipal administration and elected representatives: Dialogue Phase. - A pilot project in Nordre Follo Municipality aimed at improving dialogue between elected representatives, the administration and residents: Task Forum. - A pilot project in Vestland County Municipality and 18 municipalities in the county concerning host municipality cooperation across local government levels in the fields of services for older persons and closed archives. - A pilot project in Oslo Municipality involving the delegation of decision-making authority in cases concerning the remission or reduction of property tax. Duration and Budget Framework The pilot projects will, as a general rule, run for up to four years from their commencement. The evaluation assignment will cover the entire pilot period and will also include follow-up work in connection with the preparation of the final report. The final report must be submitted no later than 1 November 2030. The contractor may be required to participate in meetings and/or gatherings with the municipalities participating in the pilot scheme, organized by the Norwegian Association of Local and Regional Authorities (KS) and/or the Ministry. The maximum budget for the procurement is NOK 8,000,000, excluding VAT. This amount includes all costs associated with the assignment. Payments will be made upon delivery of agreed deliverables, cf. Annex 5 to the contract. The procurement is subject to the Norwegian Parliament’s approval of the proposed budget. For a more detailed description of the deliverables, please refer to Annex 1 to the contract.

title: Y--BDO BLM ESR RANGE FENCE CONSTRUCTION
description: The Department of Interior (DOI), Wildland Fire Programs at the National Interagency Fire Center (NIFC) in Boise, Idaho anticipates issuing a solicitation for the following repairs: With Government-furnished materials, work entails furnishing labor and equipment to construct one permanent fence. Permanent fence construction shall consist of a 4-wire fence constructed with t-posts and steel post structures. Permanent fence construction shall consist of barbed top and middle wires with smooth bottom wire. Construction of permanent fence and steel structures shall comply with codes and standards applicable to each type of work as listed in Government- furnished specifications and technical drawings. All work will be detailed within the specific contract documents that will be posted with the solicitation on SAM.gov. Project Location: The project site in located in Ada County, Idaho. The DOI anticipates issuing a Total Small Business Set-Aside competitive solicitation on or about August 10, 2026. The DOI anticipates issuing a single firm-fixed price award from this solicitation. The construction work is anticipated to begin Immediately upon award from the stated solicitation. Specific period of performance restrictions will be listed with the posted solicitation). Davis Bacon Act (DBA) is applicable, and the appropriate DBA Wage Determination(s) will be included in the solicitation. The competitive solicitation, 140L3726Q0131, will be posted in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 19.5, Set-Asides for Small Business. The NAICS code for this acquisition is 238990 - All Other Specialty Trade Contractors, and the size standard is $19M (per the SBA's Table of Small Business Size Standards). A Request for Quotation (RFQ) solicitation package will be available electronically on or about August 10, 2026, at www.sam.gov and will be posted for approximately 2 weeks. Potential offerors are responsible for monitoring www.sam.gov for the release of the solicitation package, for any other pertinent information, and for downloading a complete copy of the solicitation package. The government will not provide paper copies or email the solicitation. To be eligible for contract award, offerors must be registered and complete the online Representations and Certification in the System for Award Management (SAM) data base via website: http://www.sam.gov. If a site visit is conducted a date, time and meeting location will be announced in the solicitation. Offerors are highly encouraged to attend any scheduled site visit to inspect the site and to ensure they fully understand the requirement and conditions that may affect the cost of the project, specifications, and performance. Award will be based on Best Value to the Government in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR). The Government reserves the right to award a contract to other than the low offeror(s). This notice does not obligate the government to award a contract, nor does it obligate the government to pay for any proposal preparation costs.

title: Switzerland – Microscopes – Beschaffung eines cryo-konfokalen Fluoreszenzmikroskops
description: Das IBMM möchte ein fabrikneues cryo-konfokales Fluoreszenzmikroskop (cryo-kFM) beschaffen, welches in einen cryo-CLEM Workflow für zelluläre cryo-ET und in situ Strukturbiologie integriert werden soll. Das cryo-kFM soll mit mindestens 4 Fluoreszenzkanälen (Lasern) ausgestattet sein sowie über ein hochsensitives, hochauflösendes Detektorsystem verfügen für die Konfokalmikroskopie. Das Mikroskopsystem soll es zudem erlauben, zwischen Konfokal- und Widefield-Fluoreszenzmikroskopie zu wechseln, indem es mit entsprechenden Lichtquellen, Filtern und Kamera ausgestattet ist. Zudem soll es mit mindestens einem cryo-kompatiblen Luftobjektiv mit möglichst hoher numerischer Apertur und einer mindestens 50-fachen Vergrösserung ausgestattet sein. Weiter soll das cryo-kFM über eine cryo-Stage verfügen, welche es erlaubt die Proben (cryo-EM Grids mit vitrifizierten Zellen) bei < -150°C zu laden, abzubilden und auszuladen, ohne dass die Proben je eine höhere Temperatur ausgesetzt sind, und ohne dass die Proben durch kondensierende Luftfeuchtigkeit signifikant kontaminiert werden. Die cryo-Stage muss mit gängigen cryo-EM grids und sogenannten AutoGrids für die weiteren cryo-CLEM Schritte kompatibel sein. Die motorisierte cryo-Stage soll in die Benutzeroberfläche der Software zur Bedienung des cryo-kFM integriert sein. Diese Benutzeroberfläche soll möglichst einfach und effizient zu bedienen sein; das gesamte Mikroskopsystem soll über eine komplette, nutzungsbereite Hardware und Software verfügen. Besonders wichtig sind hohe Bildgebungsqualität, Robustheit bei der Bergung der abgebildeten Proben ohne Qualitätsverlust für die nächsten cryo-CLEM Schritte (cryo-FIB milling und cryo-ET), sowie Benutzerfreundlichkeit.
